name: chronicle-docs
description: Draft or update high-quality technical documentation in the Obsidian vault, with clear structure, Obsidian-ready frontmatter, tags, rationale, and examples. TRIGGER when: user asks to document something, write or update docs/notes, add a page to the Obsidian vault / knowledge base, "chronicle this", or "write this up". DO NOT TRIGGER for: code comments, repo README/docs, or PR descriptions (use describe-pr).
